english.note: Use this construction when someone says something while yawning, rather than using 打喊露 alone as a speech-reporting verb.

examples.english: They yawn as they say, “I’m really sleepy.”
examples.traditional: 佢一邊打喊露一邊講：「我真係好眼瞓。」
